policy: Exact serialized hierarchy and original Level3D resources. Runtime account state and loading selection are explicit inputs, never inferred from node names or screenshots.

facts: _ui resource under RegionMapSetting.uiRoot (+0x70), _model under buildingRoot (+0x78), _ground under groundRoot (+0x80).
Instantiate receives r8d=0 (worldPositionStays=false); original local transforms are preserved.
cfg.uiRect is not used to assign Level3D mesh-root transforms in Load.
showType=0 loads unlocked source levels. showType=1 loads current level then neighboring cfg intersecting player-centered radius.
_InitUI checks level unlocked state before changing loaded ui/building/ground active flags.
No player current level or unlock flags are embedded in the prefab.
For a RectTransform icon, set anchorMin=anchorMax=(posXZ - uiRect.center)/uiRect.size + (0.5,0.5), and anchoredPosition=(0,0).
This is icon mapping, not a new transform for source model meshes.
Rotation target _moveFinalRotation belongs to loadedRegionTransform (+0xd8), the Watch view.domainRoot passed by caller.
DORotateQuaternion applies a world quaternion, not a local Euler override on each ModelNode.
Player marker world point is transformed by the supplied center transform inverse; supplied domainRoot local position receives (-localX,-localY,0).

renderer_limits: Unity scheduling, resource-load completion, account state, postprocessing and pixel-identical engine rendering are not established by these static exports.
